scenarios.scenario-1: Dashboard submit sends prompt plus structured attachment refs through HTTP transport.
scenarios.scenario-2: Server rejects malformed attachment payloads and accepts valid structured arrays.
scenarios.scenario-3: Settings/bootstrap surfaces expose current model image-input support for composer prewarn decisions.
scenarios.scenario-4: `/api/models` returns per-model image-input capability flags alongside current-route capability state.
scenarios.scenario-5: Image `dataUrl` submit payloads above the legacy 256 KiB body limit reach `submitPrompt` instead of failing with HTTP 413.
scenarios.scenario-6: Server bridge submit failures surface API `error` bodies instead of generic retry copy.
